hand_pose.comment: Per-joint bend in DEGREES toward the palm. mcp = base knuckle, pip = middle joint, dip = tip joint. Index kept nearly straight to point; middle/ring/pinky curled into the palm; thumb relaxed. All angles read live from this file. Contact target for this frame: left_mouse_button.

arm_pose.comment: Right-arm shaping ONLY (shoulder -> upper arm -> elbow -> wrist; NOT the full body rig). All values read live from this file.

elbow_pole.comment: Where the elbow is pulled, in METRES from the shoulder, in the character's own axes. forward (+) keeps the elbow in front of the chest so the arm reaches from the front; side (+) folds it out to the character's right so it clears the torso; down (+) drops it below the shoulder. reach.comment: Forward reach envelope (metres from the shoulder) for the approach, the clavicle lift (degrees) as the hand rises toward the contact, and the wrist hover (metres) so the down-pointing fingertip settles onto the top surface instead of stopping in the air.

rig_pose.side_comment: Which arm/hand this frame drives. All bone names below are the RIGHT-side mixamo bones; the motor wires exactly these bones (no hardcoded guessing). Mirror to mixamorig:Left* for the left hand.

arm_chain.comment: Bones the two-bone arm IK rotates to carry the hand to the contact. shoulder=clavicle, upper_arm=shoulder joint, forearm=elbow, hand=wrist.

finger_bones.comment: Per-finger joint chains (base -> tip) the hand_pose angles bend. 'index' also drives the press contact (its last bone is the end_effector fingertip). These are the exact bones the rig wires for this frame.

spine_chain.comment: Trunk bones the reach leans toward the contact when the arm alone can't reach (e.g. a target on a tall desk top or placed far forward). Starts at Spine (not Hips) so the feet/pelvis stay planted while the upper body bends over the target. The lean ANGLE is computed live from the reach deficit; body_pose.spine_lean_deg caps it.

sceneStateLog.scene_contact_point_comment: Unity WORLD-space point the effector actually contacts (NOT the UI-space 'coordinates'/'rig_pose.ik_target' above). Left at 0,0,0 = AUTO: the motor targets the resized visible top of the target automatically. To pin an exact point, copy the 'Auto visible-top = (...)' value from the [KleinPress] console log into x/y/z.

hand_pose.comment: Per-joint bend in DEGREES toward the palm. mcp = base knuckle, pip = middle joint, dip = tip joint. Index kept nearly straight to point; middle/ring/pinky curled into the palm; thumb relaxed. All angles read live from this file. Contact target for this frame: enter_key.

arm_pose.comment: Right-arm shaping ONLY (shoulder -> upper arm -> elbow -> wrist; NOT the full body rig). The arm two-bone IK reaches the contact from the FRONT with the elbow folded down-and-out, so the hand raises from the front instead of swinging up from the spine, and the limb never passes through the torso. All values read live from this file.

elbow_pole.comment: Where the elbow is pulled, in METRES from the shoulder, in the character's own axes. forward (+) keeps the elbow in front of the chest so the arm reaches from the front; side (+) folds it out to the character's right so it clears the torso; down (+) drops it below the shoulder. The forward term is what stops the elbow folding behind the backbone.

reach.comment: Forward reach envelope (metres from the shoulder) for the approach, the clavicle lift (degrees) as the hand rises toward the contact, and the wrist hover (metres) so the down-pointing fingertip settles onto the top surface instead of stopping in the air.
